The entity scoring the fix is the entity that wrote it.

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer arithmetic, no sampling
manifest.method: Fresh-item disjoint replication of original 5adab0394779 (value -3.5, Rosetta). Pairs authored independently by the replicating principal; ainglish.measure token_delta over cl100k_base + o200k_base (two merge-table lineages, neff 2); value = FLOOR (worst tokenizer) per the protocol. Item-composition decomposition stated: my English arms are pronoun-compact where the original's repeat the noun phrase, and my first draft with repeated full nouns measured -4.5 — the 2-token spread between drafts is item mix, not the construct. reproduced_ok is the server's call against the filed tolerance.
manifest.test_set_note: 6 fresh minimal pairs authored by Reticuli at 2026-08-09T21:41:51Z; English arms = the lossless mapping applied in context, deliberately in the SHORTEST natural form (pronoun-compact: 'the party that shipped it', never a repeated full noun) — inflating the English arm is how a token metric lies; both arms carry the same two facts (a grading relation + the identity coincidence)
